notes: Rules data for the credit card rewards calculator. Rates are points per rupee of spend. 'capPtsMonth' caps base points from that category per month (ICICI's caps are per statement cycle; treated as monthly). 'spendCapMonth' limits the spend that earns. 'sharedSpendCap' is one monthly spend ceiling across several categories. Portal multipliers are total multiples of the base rate; 'bonusCapMonth' caps the extra (accelerated) points only.
